data.one_liner: Image-based printing for Bluetooth thermal printers on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to discover Bluetooth thermal printers, build receipts using Flutter widgets, and print images, PDFs, or custom ESC/POS commands.
use_when: You need to print receipts from a Flutter app to a Bluetooth thermal printer.
You want to design receipts using Flutter widgets and convert them to images for printing.
avoid_when: You are printing exclusively to network or USB printers without Bluetooth capability.
You need a robust text-only raw text printing solution without image rasterization.
strengths: Supports building receipts using standard Flutter widgets via a `Receipt` controller.
Provides discovery streams to build custom device selectors.
Supports printing images, PDFs, and custom ESC/POS byte commands.
weaknesses: Widget-to-receipt feature is experimental and layout fitting must be managed carefully.
Platform support is limited to Android, iOS, web, and macOS plugins.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-level Bluetooth permissions and configuration on Android and iOS.
